usageNotes: Use this to inspect a specific HA rule by its config ID — useful when verifying placement constraints before migrating VMs or modifying HA groups. Requires `Sys.Audit` on the root path (`/`), so API tokens must carry that privilege. The rule identifier must match the `pve-configid` format (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed, no spaces).

examples.summary: Read a node-affinity HA rule named 'prod-nodes'

tips: Rule identifiers are case-sensitive and must be valid pve-configid strings — check with list_cluster_ha_rules first if unsure of the exact name.

The response type field distinguishes node-affinity rules (restrict which nodes a resource can run on) from resource-affinity rules (co-locate or separate resources); use this to understand the rule's effect before modifying HA group membership.
This endpoint is read-only and safe to call frequently for audit or monitoring purposes.
